notes.title: Marie's Room Supporter Package - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Roomies, 
It’s been some time since our last update. 

If you weren’t aware, we’ve been busy pouring our souls into [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211930/Ghost_on_the_Shore/][i]Ghost on the Shore[/i][/url], our new game that expands on the format of [i]Marie’s Room[/i], combining thoughtful, exploratory gameplay alongside choices-matter narrative, all set against the backdrop of atmospheric Atlantic islands. 

[b]But we’ve got very exciting [i]Marie’s Room[/i] news too! [/b]

Today, we’re thrilled to reveal the [i]Marie’s Room[/i] Supporter Package. Marie’s Room has always been - and will always remain - free to play. We created the game as a short, standalone experience and have been overwhelmed with the critical praise it has achieved over its lifespan. After now nearly 500k downloads, we wanted to create a special edition for those of you who want to support the development team directly, and contribute towards an industry with space for short innovative and emotionally driven experiences. 

[u]The Supporter Package includes: [/u]
[list]
[*] The full [i]Marie’s Room[/i] game. 
[*] 10 track original soundtrack by Dries Vienne & Simon Alexander + an exclusive extra bonus track by Ward Snauwaert and Memoria Lane (Kenny, co-founder and creative director of like Charlie).
[*] 21 page digital art book including ‘Marie’s Journal’ and a look behind the scenes of the game's development. 
[/list]
Re-live the story of Marie and Kelsey with the Supporter Package and put your endorsement behind innovative, indie titles.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25600/Maries_Room_Supporter_Package/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078683/ac8266bf772136113a3ba3335281e3a03f0473d3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Our next game, Ghost on the Shore, launches: Feb 24th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

It’s been a while since we last shared an update with you. As you can imagine, this is because we’ve been very busy working on our next game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211930/Ghost_on_the_Shore/]Ghost on the Shore[/url]. 

If you haven’t heard of Ghost on the Shore before, it’s very much a thematic sequel to Marie’s Room; gameplay is pensive, and exploratory; the story is told through voiceover; there are items to pick up and from which you will learn about the world and discover the story. 

This time, however you have a whole [i]island[/i] to explore! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078683/5d6697ecd875dda083bc03622591e851da065eb1.gif[/img]

[h3]🏕[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211930/Ghost_on_the_Shore/]Visit the Ghost on the Shore Steam page.[/url][/b][/h3]

You play as Riley, a young woman looking for a fresh start, who arrives on a small archipelago after being forced to ground in a storm. Joining with you on your adventure is Josh, a headstrong ghost, whose voice becomes known to Riley as soon as she sets foot on the islands. 
Expanding on the format of Marie’s Room, you will speak with Josh as you learn the tragic tale of what happened to these atmospheric, now abandoned islands. 
Take care in your dialogue choices! Conversations help shape the game and can dramatically affect the way your story ends. 

This week, we were really excited to announce that Ghost on the Shore will launch on Steam on 24th February. 

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Discover the [b]branching narrative[/b] and [b]multiple endings[/b].
[*] Make [b]emotional choices[/b] and experience the [b]consequences[/b].
[*] Immerse yourself into a [b]rich story[/b] and [b]atmospheric setting[/b].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078683/a83355694fb7aac2f118685c4b0271f32a704c4b.gif[/img]

If you enjoyed Marie’s Room, we’re certainly you’ll love Ghost on the Shore and we hope you will be interested in adding it to your wishlist, and playing when it launches at the end of the month. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078683/a0f4df297dbf0f635f2dd37fa97d5dc5bcaf964b.gif[/img]

Until then, “I am not a shadow person” - but I know somebody who is. 

[h3]👉 [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211930/Ghost_on_the_Shore/]Add Ghost on the Shore to your Steam wishlist![/url][/b] 👈[/h3]

notes.title: Ghost on the Shore teaser video by creators of Marie´s Room
notes.content:
We´re happy to announce our next exploration game Ghost on the Shore! You welcomed Marie´s Room with open arms and showed us incredible support. Thanks to you we´re here today and able to work on our next game. We´re proud to reveal the first footage of Ghost on the Shore.

View the teaser in Youtube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kfkx7AE_QOw]Teaser[/url]
Wishlist the game in Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211930/Ghost_on_the_Shore/?beta=0]Ghost on the Shore[/url]

[previewyoutube=kfkx7AE_QOw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]GHOST ON THE SHORE[/h2]
[b]Ghost on the Shore is a story and relationship exploration game about emotional ties that transcend even death.[/b]

You play as Riley, a young woman who finds herself stranded on a desolate island with a headstrong ghost, dead for as long as he can remember. 

As you explore the crumbling homes of the gone islanders and discover the remnants, you get to know the ghost Josh. Making irrevocable choices in dialogue you shape the bond with him, which ultimately influences the outcome of the game. 

As Riley puts it all together, she comes to understand how an island’s history led to Josh’ death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078683/080743cb8caf8ceb8175fcaa8522c17f4f2f97bc.png[/img]

[h2]FEATURES[/h2][list]
[*] Relationship exploration
[*] Environmental storytelling
[*] Emotional choices with consequences
[*] Branching narrative with multiple endings
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078683/bb53bfbbaf607ca5f94050f2836a7bec06d0a16b.png[/img]

[h2]THE SECRET INGREDIENTS[/h2]
[b]Relationship exploration[/b] is a unique feature that allows the player to make choices in a subtle immersive way. Often all one has, is the power of words. And it is your choice to reach out or to alienate. Like in real life, you don't always know how your words will affect the other. Or what future they hold.

[b]Emotional storytelling[/b] is something that we are both passionate and curious about. Players identify deeply with characters of flesh and blood that they can relate to. Through complex characters we´re able to tell stories that trigger a universal set of emotions.

Thank you for being with us on this journey!

- like Charlie team

notes.title: News update - Brand new gamestudio!
notes.content:
Hi all!

There is a very good reason why it's been so quiet from our end. And we're about to tell you all about it.

When Marie’s Room was Greenlit almost two years ago, we never dreamed the release of it more than a year later would be met with so much love.

We were blown away by the number of instant players. We loved the positive feedback and praised ourselves lucky that we’d found all of you.

Soon we realized that if we ever wanted to start our own studio, this was the time to do it.

So, that's what we did.

We started a game studio - like Charlie.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31078683/4faf3a049fc8510870f73701ed5e3060c158005a.png[/img]

There is a website: www.likeCharlie.com. And we’d love for you to sign up for our newsletter, so we can tell you all about our games and other crazy adventures.

And we're on Twitter, of course - @LCharlieGames: https://twitter.com/LCharlieGames

Please stay in touch.
Dagmar & Kenny

notes.title: Blog and news update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while! First of all, I'd like to thank you all for all the support you've given us, and the game. Thank you so much!

I'm aware that a few people have crashes when a video is supposed to play. I've looked into this problem, a few times now, and have spent countless hours to get it reproduced or fixed. But without success. I'm really sorry for this. All I can recommend is you make sure you have all the latest drivers installed of your video card. This was helpful for a handful of people.

'Marie's Room' has been a great ride, and has enabled me, and the team to think about what's next. So stay tuned for that, some great news coming up!

One last thing, for those who are interested, I started a blog on my new website. The first post deals with the early days of developing Marie's Room.
You can find it here: https://www.kennyguillaume.com/blog

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31078683/705cf83e7f3b57217dd728b3ebacf9cd36454ed7.jpg[/img]

Thanks again!
See you next time.
-Kenny

notes.title: update on the game - fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First of all, thank you so much for the continuing support. We love it!
The last couple of days I've been working on a few fixes.

[*]The spawning bug in the beginning of the game. Since I can't reproduce this, I'm not entirely sure if this update fixes it. In any case, let me know with a reply to this post if you still experience the issue. (again, just restarting the game does fix this problem).
[*]The game doesn't start in fullscreen anymore. Since a few people had problems with menu not reacting to the mouse, flickering,.. and so on.
Hope this is a fix for those people.
Please make sure to delete your Settings.sav file first, located here: 
C:\Users\(user)\AppData\Local\MariesRoom\Saved\SaveGames
before you try again.

That's all for now. Again, for everyone who already played, thank you so much!

-Kenny
